question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is- **"Vehical".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, "**Vehical"** is the incorrectly spelt word.
 
• The right spelling of the word is- **"Vehicle".**
 
• Thus,** *option 2)*** is the correct alternative.
